description: Sealed cases. run.py refuses to generate a sealed case, or any case whose prompt has the same normalized sha256, unless --hero-run is given. Only the prompt is checked in routine work, through the 'qmg brief' dry run, which generates nothing.
prompt_normalization: sha256 of the UTF-8 prompt after str.strip(), lower-casing and collapsing runs of whitespace to one space

sealed.baseline: Its draft-v0 output (out/benchmark-draft/q2-showcase-hero) is baseline-0 evidence and may be re-evaluated read-only; it is not generated again outside the hero run.
